planets.name: HD 88986 b
planets.description: HD 88986 b crosses its star every 146 days and is 2.5 times as wide as Earth, found in 2023.

text.card: HD 88986 b was found in 2023 by Haute-Provence Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 88986. Its orbit and size follow Heidari et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
